chapter_title_en: The Capture of the Black Tai Sui
chapter_seo_title: Chapter 236 - Li Huowang’s Flesh-Sacrifice Trap for the Black Tai Sui
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang tracks the Black Tai Sui through the dark, faces a new predator called the flesh hook, and peels his own chest open to capture the entity alive with the Thousand Greats Record.

twitter_title: Li Huowang Trades His Skin for a Cure
twitter_description: The hunt for the Black Tai Sui ends in a bloody, self-sacrificing trap as Li Huowang uses his own flesh as a net.

lore_anchors.definition: A parasitic entity of writhing black flesh and tentacles, derived from the folk-deity Tai Sui. In the novel, it is used as an alchemical ingredient to suppress madness.
A ritual from the Thousand Greats Record where the practitioner tears off their own skin, which then expands into a living binding agent.
A fast-moving predator glimpsed in this chapter. Its name evokes a butcher’s tool reanimated as a living weapon.
Li Huowang’s dog, used as a scent-hound to track supernatural entities. Its name means “steamed bun.”
